name: Aluminium Chloride + Melaleuca Alternifolia Oil + Geothermal water
indication_description: This spray is indicated for the tratment of Hyperhidrosis.
dosage_description: Initially apply this spray in the morning & evening after drying the affected areas carefully. The frequency of application may be reduced to twice a week or less after improving the condition.
contraindications_description: Contraindicated in any other ingredient of this preparations.
storage_conditions_description: Keep below 30°C temperature, away from light & moisture. Keep out of the reach of children.
